method: Parses one bounded Accept field value into RFC 9110 media ranges, media parameters and q weights. Type and subtype names and parameter names are normalized to lowercase; parameter values retain their case and quoted-string escapes are decoded. q defaults to 1, must be between 0 and 1, and is restricted to at most three decimal places. For each concrete offered media type, every matching range is enumerated. Exact type/subtype takes precedence over type/*, which takes precedence over */*; at the same level, a matching range with more media parameters wins, then declaration order. The selected range alone determines quality, so a more specific q=0 excludes an offer even when a wildcard accepts it. Unmatched offers receive q=0. Positive-quality offers retain input order for highest-quality ties. This does not select language, encoding, or other negotiation dimensions and does not issue a request. Inputs are capped at 20,000 characters, 100 ranges and 100 offers.
